These statements have not been evaluated by the Food and Drug Administration. This product is not intended to diagnose, treat, cure, or prevent any disease.
All of the science and customized formulations have been developed to help your body respond better in intense training environments and supporting an anti-catabolic state.

In a double-blind, placebo-controlled, cross-over study, 25 subjects exercised on a treadmill on two occasions. On one occasion the subjects took Thermo Igniter 12X 60 minutes before exercise and on a second occasion, they took a placebo. When the subjects took Thermo Igniter 12X, they burned three times more calories before, 3% more calories during and 12 times more calories for up to one hour after exercise compared to when they took the placebo. In a 4-week randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled study of 50 healthy untrained male volunteers ages 19-29, subjects were supplemented with either one of two doses of the Muscle Fatigue Buffer or placebo. After 4 weeks of treatment, the subjects taking the Muscle Fatigue Buffer experienced significant increases in PWCFT (physical working capacity at the fatigue threshold) over the placebo group. In a randomized, double-blind clinical trial, 57 healthy young adult males took Creatine HCl and significantly improved leg press 1-RM performance by 54-lbs, while subjects on 5g creatine monohydrate improved by 52 lbs, and the placebo group did not have significant improvements. 17 healthy young adults' muscle biopsy results revealed that Creatine HCl resulted in 189% greater muscle creatine uptake relative to benchmark amounts of ordinary creatine monohydrate powder. When used in conjunction with an exercise program.
